turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why does my son have a zero in your gradebook, and why did he find out from his phone?
"Get this over with." Okay. I'm writing that down. You asked for this meeting, Hale, so start with who decided on the zero and what it was based on.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies, and you've just called him a cheater to my face. "Everyone knows it" isn't evidence, Hale, so show me a document or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I'm not bullying anyone. I'm asking what your own procedure asks: was Owen spoken to, and was I called before a mark went in? Nobody called me, Hale, so answer the question.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?

Your time? You called this meeting, and I have eighteen minutes. Either put something on this desk that I can read, or I'm walking up to the principal's office and telling him what I've heard in here.
